title: Favourable transformations

D0.outcome: Explains transforming one kind of advantage or structure into another through exchanges and breaks.

D1.outcome: In a given position, names the transformation that leads to a better structure and its cost.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, picks the exchange or break that transforms the position into one that suits him, and sheds a weak pawn when the plan calls for it.

D3.outcome: Predicts the resulting structure and phase of the transformation and checks it against the starting position.

conditions: The skeleton can still change by exchange or break.
contrasts: The transformation shifts to a structure that favours the opponent.
Shedding a weak pawn that was actually well defended.
A frozen structure with no exchange or break available.
